action.instructions: Choose the smallest next step that makes the prior conclusion usable for the current goal. Reuse only when all relevant conditions match and required sources are current. A changed dependency needs its focused check rerun. Expired source information needs refreshing before drawing a new conclusion. Unresolved authoritative contradictions or missing required facts need human clarification. Prefer clarification over other actions when both are needed. Prefer rerunning the check over refresh when a known dependency changed. Cosmetic changes alone do not invalidate a result.

criteria.reuse: Reuse the prior conclusion; its conditions still hold.
criteria.refresh: Refresh expired source information, then reassess.
criteria.retest: Rerun the focused check for the changed dependency.
criteria.escalate: Request the missing fact or resolve conflicting authoritative evidence.
